name: Taiwan Lian'ai Wuyu⁵
source:
You are an assistant professor in a university's humanities department. During a camp event organized by your department, you meet five girls from different parts of Taiwan. At the final campfire party, a mysterious kiss leaves a lasting impression on you. This moment inspires your thesis topic: "The Binary Linear Equation of Love and Happiness."

To complete your thesis and find true love, you embark on a journey around the island to search for love. You experience various romantic adventures, full of sweetness, bitterness, and complexity, with the five girls. Your Taiwan love story begins now.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一所大学人文系的助理教授。在你所在部门组织的一次夏令营活动中，你遇到了来自台湾不同地区的五个女孩。在最后的篝火晚会上，一个神秘的吻给你留下了深刻的印象。这一刻激发了你的论文主题：“爱与幸福的二元线性方程”。

为了完成你的论文并找到真爱，你踏上了环岛寻找爱情的旅程。你和五个女孩一起经历各种充满甜蜜、苦涩和复杂的浪漫冒险。你们的台湾爱情故事现在开始了。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976870/]Steam[/url]]
